domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator for unlike fractional parts.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtracting.
Tag in pure-fraction items or mixed-number items when unlike fractional parts must be made comparable.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag when a number is only normalized, such as converting an improper mixed number to standard mixed form.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that convert 1 whole into denominator-over-denominator units after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a starting number into an equivalent, more workable form before subtraction, such as standardizing an improper mixed number or simplifying a starting fraction part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is rewritten into standard mixed-number form.
Tag when a starting fraction part is simplified before subtraction, such as 4/10 to 2/5.
Tag only when the rewrite is applied to an operand before the subtraction is carried out.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion done solely to create a common denominator.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that belongs to mixed-number alignment.
Do not tag simplification of the final answer after subtraction.

skills.name: Align mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers and mixed numbers in aligned whole-part and fraction-part form so corresponding parts can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over the relevant denominator.
Tag when the solution explicitly separates or matches whole parts and fraction parts for mixed-number, whole-minus-fraction, or whole-minus-mixed subtraction.
Tag preparatory representation steps that make later whole-part and fraction-part subtraction possible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number into standard mixed form.
Do not tag the actual subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts once the representation is already set.
Do not tag final recombination into the answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction once quantities are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole parts and fraction parts separately in mixed-number problems.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fractions are subtracted by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
Tag when mixed-number solutions subtract whole parts and fraction parts separately.
Tag even if the intermediate fractional result is zero or negative before any regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the prior step of finding a common denominator or aligning mixed-number parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the quantities after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag final simplification or final presentation alone if no subtraction is performed in that step.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow 1 from the whole-number part and convert it into fractional units when the fractional subtraction cannot be completed directly.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part after a negative or insufficient fractional difference appears.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator units and added to the fractional part before subtracting.
Tag in mixed-minus-mixed, whole-minus-mixed, or whole/mixed-minus-fraction cases requiring borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when no borrowing or regrouping is needed.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts without converting 1 whole into fractional units.
Do not tag initial operand normalization done before subtraction begins.

skills.name: Finalize simplified result
skills.definition: Combine computed whole and fractional parts and express the answer in lowest terms, including reducing to a fraction, mixed number, integer, or zero as appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution combines separate whole-part and fraction-part results into one final answer.
Tag when the final result is simplified, including reducing a fraction, converting 0 over n to 0, omitting a zero whole part, or recognizing a whole number result.
Tag end-of-solution presentation steps that both express and simplify the result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate operand rewrites performed before subtraction.
Do not tag subtraction operations themselves unless the step explicitly finalizes the answer.
Do not tag preparatory simplification of a starting operand before subtraction.
